record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a Riemannian manifold (M, g), determine whether (M, g) admits a Hessian structure.

evidence.quote: Hessian structure in a Riemannian manifold (M, g)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth Riemannian manifold. A Hessian structure on $M$ compatible with $g$ is a pair $(
abla, g)$ where $
abla$ is a torsion-free, flat affine connection on $M$ (so that around every point there exist local affine coordinates $x^1,\dots,x^n$ with $
abla\,dx^i = 0$) such that, in a neighborhood of every point, there exists a smooth function $\varphi$ with
$$g_{ij} =  rac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial x^i \partial x^j}$$
in those affine coordinates; equivalently, $g = 
abla\, d\varphi$ locally. A Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ is said to admit a Hessian structure if there exists a flat torsion-free affine connection $
abla$ on $M$ such that $(
abla,g)$ is a Hessian structure.

Problem: Provide necessary and sufficient conditions on a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ for it to admit a Hessian structure. In particular, give a characterization (in terms of curvature, topology, or other intrinsic invariants of $(M,g)$) that decides whether such a flat affine connection $
abla$ exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Only partial results are known. Necessary obstructions include vanishing of Pontryagin forms, vanishing Euler characteristic, and (for compact manifolds) an infinite torsion-free fundamental group. Sufficient conditions and classification results exist in special cases (e.g., Koszul-type Hessian manifolds, compact ones with abelian fundamental group, confirmation of Chern's conjecture in the Hessian setting), but no general necessary-and-sufficient intrinsic characterization of which Riemannian manifolds admit a Hessian structure is known. The general existence question therefore appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On Topology and Geometry of Hessian Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: For Hessian manifolds of Koszul type, equivalence with positive flat line bundles... Chern's conjecture confirmed for Hessian manifolds; compact Hessian manifolds with abelian fundamental group classified.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides partial characterizations and classifications but not a full intrinsic existence criterion.

status_evidence.title: On Hessian Riemannian Structures (Duistermaat)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Hessian Riemannian structures and obstructions.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational study; existence problem treated locally and in special situations.

status_evidence.title: Curvature of Hessian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Pontryagin forms must vanish on a Hessian manifold.
status_evidence.claim: Known topological obstructions are necessary but not sufficient.
